message: Unpaywall title search was retired on 2026-09-18. Use OpenAlex instead: https://api.openalex.org/works?search=YOUR+QUERY . OpenAlex is the successor to Unpaywall, from the same team, and Unpaywall now runs on the OpenAlex database, so it is the same data. More: https://help.openalex.org/access/unpaywall/#unpaywall-and-openalex
